findings.title: Other subgroup-stream methods still dereference a possibly deleted delegate
findings.body: The fix recognizes that modelSupplier.get() can return null when the cached group is deleted concurrently, but the three paginated/search getSubGroupsStream overloads at lines 256, 262, and 268 still call modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) without a null check. If deletion occurs after the GroupAdapter is obtained but before one of these methods delegates to the database, the same concurrent-deletion scenario therefore still produces a NullPointerException and a server error instead of being handled consistently with getSubGroupsCount().

findings.title: Reader thread is never joined before asserting that no exceptions occurred
findings.body: The background reader thread is started without keeping a reference, and after deletedAll is set the test immediately asserts that caughtExceptions is empty. The reader may still be in the middle of a groups request at that point and may add the very server-error exception this regression test is meant to catch only after the assertion has passed, so the test can pass spuriously. The unjoined thread can also leak into subsequent tests and keep calling the admin API; if a deletion throws, deletedAll is never set and the loop can run indefinitely. Store the thread, stop it in a finally block, and join it before asserting on caughtExceptions.
